user.title: Connect to Mistral AI
user.description: Enter your Mistral AI API key. Speech-to-text (Voxtral 3) and text-to-speech (Voxtral TTS 3) are set up automatically with the same key.

data_description.api_key: Create a key at console.mistral.ai with access to the Mistral Large and Voxtral models.
data_description.use_agent: Route conversations through a Mistral agent instead of a plain chat model.
data_description.agent_id: Only used when "Use a Mistral agent" is enabled.
data_description.model: Mistral chat model used for conversations and voice queries.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: Upper bound on how many Home Assistant tool calls a single request may trigger (1 to 10).
data_description.llm_hass_api: Which Home Assistant API the model may act through. Assist exposes your entities as voice intents and honours the per-entity "exposed to Assist" setting and the area of the speaking satellite.
data_description.legacy_tools: Also send HomeStral's own tools (control_ha_device, get_ha_state, list_ha_entities). They can reach entities that are not exposed to Assist, so they stay off unless you upgraded from an earlier release.
data_description.prompt: Replaces HomeStral's built-in instructions. Leave empty to keep them (short spoken answers, current time, local weather, tool guidance).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Mistral AI

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

data.stt_bias_entities: Recognise exposed entity, area and floor names

data_description.use_agent: Route conversations through a Mistral agent instead of a plain chat model.
data_description.agent_id: Only used when "Use a Mistral agent" is enabled.
data_description.model: Mistral chat model used for conversations and voice queries.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: Upper bound on how many Home Assistant tool calls a single request may trigger (1 to 10).
data_description.stt_mode: Realtime streams the audio to Voxtral while you speak and ends the turn as soon as you stop; batch uploads the whole recording once Home Assistant detects silence.
data_description.stt_turn_detection: Realtime only. Default suits most homes; aggressive ends turns sooner for short commands (more cut-offs when you pause); off relies on Home Assistant's silence detection.
data_description.stt_streaming_delay_ms: Realtime only. Lower is faster but less accurate; 480 ms is Mistral's recommended starting point.
data_description.stt_language: Send the Assist pipeline language to Voxtral, or let Voxtral detect the language.
data_description.stt_batch_model: mini is faster and cheaper, small is more accurate. Used in batch mode and as the realtime fallback.
data_description.stt_custom_vocabulary: Names and phrases to recognise, one per line or separated by commas (a family name, a device nickname).
data_description.stt_bias_entities: Adds the friendly names of the entities exposed to Assist plus your area and floor names to the recognition vocabulary.
data_description.stt_chat_fallback: If transcription returns nothing, send the audio to the Voxtral chat model as a last resort (slower).
data_description.tts_voice: Voxtral voice id used when the Assist pipeline does not select one, for example voice_592 (Marie, French). Leave empty to use the first preset voice of the spoken language.
data_description.tts_default_emotion: Delivery applied to every answer, for example calm or warm. Tested in English, expected to work in French.
data_description.tts_default_pace: Speaking rate applied to every answer, from very-slow to very-fast.
data_description.tts_expressiveness: 0 keeps Mistral's default. Between 1.0 and 5.0, higher values give a stronger delivery at the cost of voice similarity and stability.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Which Home Assistant API the model may act through. Assist exposes your entities as voice intents and honours the per-entity "exposed to Assist" setting and the area of the speaking satellite.
data_description.legacy_tools: Also send HomeStral's own tools (control_ha_device, get_ha_state, list_ha_entities). They can reach entities that are not exposed to Assist, so they stay off unless you upgraded from an earlier release.
data_description.prompt: Replaces HomeStral's built-in instructions. Leave empty to keep them (short spoken answers, current time, local weather, tool guidance).

control_device.name: Control device
control_device.description: Calls a Home Assistant service on an entity or device through HomeStral.

config_entry.name: Config entry
config_entry.description: The HomeStral config entry to use.

device_id.name: Entity or device
device_id.description: Entity ID (for example light.living_room) or device ID to control.

command.name: Command
command.description: Service to call, for example turn_on, turn_off or toggle.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: Optional service data, for example brightness or color temperature.
